messages:
alex: Heads-up — found a bad copy/paste in the README JS quickstart that trips up token rotation and error handling. Repro steps and snippet below.

alex: repro: paste the snippet into new project, forget env var, fetch call ends up sending string 'API_KEY' and 401.

alex: bad snippet:
```js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': 'Bearer API_KEY'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })
})
```

priya: Ugh, thanks. I remember we switched to using process.env in our examples. Might be an old copy from internal note. Can you open a PR?

alex: opened PR #3192 — updates sample to read from process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY and adds note about not pasting long-lived tokens into code. also adds small test in docs CI to check for literal 'API_KEY' occurrence.

sam: docs-bot: ci/detect-snippet-strings failed on branch alex/readme-snippet-fix — there are two occurrences.

docs-bot: @alex please remove the placeholder or wrap in comment so CI passes. See CI log: https://ci.redwood.dev/3192

alex: fixed, pushed. changed to:
```js
const API_KEY = process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY // set in .env or env vars
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${API_KEY}`
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'hello' })
})
```

jamie: quick note — also add a short section on SDK parity: show both fetch and @redwood/js-client usage. New devs copy whichever is convenient.

luis: +1. Also please mention retry behavior: the fetch snippet should show 429 handling or link to retry utility.

priya: assigning to me to merge after tiny edits. I'll add a line about token rotation best practices and a small QA checklist for the release.

alex: thanks — will follow up in PR comments. :thumbsup:
